description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging setup in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically for the Conduit project.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection and ILoggerFactory to configure services, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and dependency injection for core Conduit services.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication parameters, including signing credentials, issuer, audience, and token validation settings.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
